name: – Pasquale Tridico – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section IV – Court of Justice of the European Union
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Union's court (the Court of Justice) spent its 2024 budget of about 504 million euros. It notes the court handled more cases and finished more of them, and that its spending was mostly on staff. Parliament asks the court to report on how a 2024 reform moved some cases to its lower court, to keep improving the time cases take, and to make training on preventing violence against women compulsory for all staff and judges.

- Parliament formally approves the court's 2024 spending and asks for a report on the 2024 case-transfer reform.
- It affects the court's judges, staff and the national courts that send it cases.
- Next, the court must report back on the reform and on case processing times.
